question: How many percent of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73?
evidence: Percentage of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73 = (Total no. of LAM customers who consumed more than 46.73 / Total no. of LAM customers) * 100.
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching yearmonth record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Consumption > 46.73, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 LEFT JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Consumption > 46.73, 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'

c.request:
How many percent of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73?
Evidence: Percentage of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73 = (Total no. of LAM customers who consumed more than 46.73 / Total no. of LAM customers) * 100.
Also keep rows that have no matching yearmonth record.
c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ym.Consumption > 46.73 THEN c.CustomerID END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID), 0) AS percentage FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM';

d.request: What percentage of LAM customers consumed more than 46.73, while retaining rows with no matching yearmonth record?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.Consumption > 46.73 THEN c.CustomerID END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID), 0) AS percentage FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM';

b.request: What percentage of all customers in the LAM segment, including those with no yearmonth record, have at least one yearmonth record with Consumption greater than 46.73?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM yearmonth y WHERE y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND y.Consumption > 46.73) THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM customers c WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM';
